steps: Chop the onion, tomato, capsicum, green chilli and coriander very fine.
Crack the eggs into a bowl and pick out any bits of shell.
Add the salt, turmeric and chilli powder, and beat with a fork until frothy.
Stir the chopped vegetables into the eggs.
Heat the oil in a frying pan on medium heat. Keep it moderate so the outside does not brown before the middle sets.
Pour in the eggs and tilt the pan so they spread into an even round.
Cook for about 2 minutes, until the bottom is set and lightly golden.
Flip it, cook the other side for a minute, then fold it over and serve hot.
note: Sources used 5 to 15 ml of fat for two eggs, so 10 ml of oil sits in the middle. Onion is raised to 20 g because two of the three sources use more than a spoonful.
